[[Polikhim Hobo]] |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =Yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|So, Sherlock, you want a riddle? You’re our pro on these headcrackers, right? Here, look. One lame hobo came around here. Either nuts of just demented, hell if I knew. All in rags, dirty head to toe, and the stench! A walking chemical weapon. Launched one on some vector, and where he goes, everything dies off. Hehe. Oh, damn, laughter through tears. But I digress. Just wanted to dispose of him, a bit farther away so the stink wouldn’t reach us, but one of our boys recognized his former homie in that pile of turd. Imagine that! Horrid things are going on, turning people from normal beings to such rubbish, and all for nothing! But that's not the point. The dude that recognized this heap of rags, said that he was not just a regular prick, but a Deputy Head of Security for two special sensitive zones on the Polikhim! Just imagine what kind of source could he become if he could at least remember his name, not just chew snots and mumble while slapping lips like a madman. What a shame! I don't know what got to him, but here's what I think. All this time that bagger lived somewhere, sleeping on some pissed-through mattresses, right? Right! You should look for that place. Need a hazmat suit? Haha, kidding. But if it comes to it, the hazmat’s on me, and not only it.}} ==Requirements== * Must be level 10 to start this quest. ==Objectives== * Obtain [[Secure Folder 0013|information]] about the Deputy Chief's past life on [[Customs]] ** (''Optional'') Locate the sleeping place of the former Deputy Chief of Security on [[Customs]] * Hand over the [[Secure Folder 0013|information]] to [[Skier]] * Obtain [[Dorm room 220 key|items]] that can help the investigation * Hand over the [[Dorm room 220 key|items]] to [[Skier]] ==Rewards== * +4,800 [[EXP]] * [[Skier]] Rep '''+0.04''' * 15,000 Roubles ** 15,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 17,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[MSA ACH TC-2002 MICH Series helmet (Olive Drab)]] {{quote|How long I live and wonder still. How was he surviving all this time? He can’t put two words together! Whatever.
